# DOMPurify

`purify.es.mjs` is the unmodified browser module from DOMPurify 3.4.16.
`DOMPurify-LICENSE` contains its license. The editor serves both files locally.

Source: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/3.4.16
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.4.16.tgz

The package SHA-512 checksum is:

```text
sqo+pNp3qRhCIpbgRi1y8Tgk27Bo2Ry7w0dC1NBeNTdZChWjz9Xb/KOoZbRP/R6pQZ80Qw8YhXw13hWWBbMRnQ==
```

To update, replace the module and license from a published package, verify its
registry checksum, update this file, and run the browser regression tests.
